measured_semantics_in_order: 1. `if (info.isClient) continue` — a 'use client' module is skipped outright.
2. `if (info.isUseServer && this.isUnderCheckedDir(info.rel))` — a 'use server' module under app/ or components/ is CHECKED unconditionally.
3. `if (!this.isUnderCheckedDir(info.rel)) continue` — anything outside app/ and components/ is never checked.
4. `if (this.isEntryPointFile(info.rel))` — an entrypoint basename under a checked dir is CHECKED.

5. `else if (this.reachesDatabase(info.abs))` — otherwise, a module that can reach the database is CHECKED, under the scanner's own comment: 'Form 1: a server component shipped under the app/component trees that can reach the database is checked exactly like a page — it runs during render, outside any open context.'

why_EH5_UNBOUND_is_reported_rather_than_.the_risk_of_silent_discard: If NULL-bound assignments were merely dropped, a run in which EVERY assignment lacks a version binding would report EH-5 as 0 over 0, or as a perfect ratio over whatever few bindings exist, while being wholly uncalculable. That is the same class of defect this authority forbids elsewhere: a ratio that looks right because its denominator quietly shrank.
why_EH5_UNBOUND_is_reported_rather_than_.why_this_is_not_a_seventh_indicator_or_a: It is a disclosed component of EH-5's own denominator derivation, which the EVIDENCE_HEALTH universal shape obligation already requires ('an explicit denominator'). A reader cannot verify a denominator whose exclusions are invisible.
why_EH5_UNBOUND_is_reported_rather_than_.measured_precedent_in_the_parent_itself: EH-3's frozen shape is 'count sufficient / insufficient / UNDETERMINED over active outcomes'. A third bucket reported beside a ratio over a stated denominator is therefore an ESTABLISHED shape in this very contract, not an invention of PF3's. EH5_UNBOUND is EH-5's 'undetermined'.
why_EH5_UNBOUND_is_reported_rather_than_.no_composite_score: EH5_UNBOUND is a count with the same denominator-visible discipline as every other indicator. It is never combined with the ratio into a grade, index or health score.

recorded_tension_with_the_calculation_en.finding: The SROI calculation engine does NOT treat a NULL version binding the way EH-5 now does, and an exact-object auditor comparing the two will find this. It is recorded rather than left to be discovered.
recorded_tension_with_the_calculation_en.primary_source: lib/pipeline/sroi-calculation.ts:982-983 states, in the repository's own words, that 'A NULL financialProxyVersionId (no version was ever bound) is exactly as fatal as an unapproved one.' The guard at :989 reads: if (enforceApproval && (!proxyVersion || proxyVersion.reviewStatus !== 'approved')) — and it raises the SAME error for both cases, at :991, reporting financialProxyVersionId=null.
recorded_tension_with_the_calculation_en.so_the_engine_treats_NULL_as: EQUIVALENT TO UNAPPROVED — a reason to fail the whole calculation closed.
recorded_tension_with_the_calculation_en.so_EH5_treats_NULL_as: NOT AN ASSIGNED VERSION — outside the ratio entirely, and reported as EH5_UNBOUND.
recorded_tension_with_the_calculation_en.why_both_are_correct_for_their_own_quest: The engine asks 'may I compute a value from this assignment?', and for that question an unbound version and an unapproved one are equally disqualifying. EH-5 asks 'of the versions assigned in this run, how many are approved?', and for that question an assignment with no version bound contributes no version to review. The two answers differ because the two questions differ.
recorded_tension_with_the_calculation_en.why_this_makes_EH5_UNBOUND_non_optional: Given the engine's stance, a run carrying NULL bindings cannot be calculated at all. An evidence-health surface that dropped those rows silently would present a healthy proxy ratio for a run that cannot produce a number. EH5_UNBOUND is what keeps EH-5 honest under the mission's own denominator rule.
recorded_tension_with_the_calculation_en.not_a_reopened_product_decision: This does not change EH-5's frozen source, shape or drill, and it does not change the calculation engine, which is outside PF3's write surface and untouched. It fixes the interpretation of one word — 'assigned' — that the parent text did not disambiguate.
